description: This file implements Python bindings for CUDA Event objects in PyTorch, including creation, IPC handle management, recording, waiting, querying, and synchronization functionalities.

classes.name: THCPEvent
classes.description: Python binding class for CUDA Event in PyTorch, managing CUDA event lifecycle and operations.

methods.name: THCPEvent_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new CUDA Event object with optional parameters.

methods.name: THCPEvent_from_ipc_handle
methods.description: Creates a CUDA Event from an IPC handle.

methods.name: THCPEvent_dealloc
methods.description: Destructor for CUDA Event object, releasing resources.

methods.name: THCPEvent_get_cuda_event
methods.description: Returns the underlying CUDA event pointer.

methods.name: THCPEvent_get_device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the CUDA event.

methods.name: THCPEvent_record
methods.description: Records the event on a given CUDA stream.

methods.name: THCPEvent_wait
methods.description: Makes the event wait on a given CUDA stream.

methods.name: THCPEvent_query
methods.description: Queries whether the event has completed.

methods.name: THCPEvent_elapsed_time
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.

methods.name: THCPEvent_synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the event, blocking until it completes.

methods.name: THCPEvent_ipc_handle
methods.description: Returns the IPC handle for the event.

methods.name: THCPEvent_init
methods.description: Initializes the CUDA Event Python type and adds it to the module.
